45601-the-four-corners.title: The Four Corners
45601-the-four-corners.creator: Amy E. Blanchard
45601-the-four-corners.description: A book by Amy E. Blanchard. he town, facing a street which ended at the front gate. At the side of the garden another long street wound its way uphill and was called the old County Road when it began to go down grade. The house was a rambling old affair which had not been painted for some years and was, therefore, of an indescribable hue.

arxiv-2010-00403.title: Mediating artificial intelligence developments through negative and positive incentives
arxiv-2010-00403.creator: The Anh Han
arxiv-2010-00403.description: Abstract Abstract The field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is going through a period of great expectations, introducing a certain level of anxiety in research, business and also policy. This anxiety is further energised by an AI race narrative that makes people believe they might be missing out.

arxiv-2109-14816.title: COVID-19 Fake News Detection Using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Based Models
arxiv-2109-14816.creator: Yuxiang Wang, Yongheng Zhang, Xuebo Li, Xinyao Yu
arxiv-2109-14816.description: Abstract Nowadays, the development of social media allows people to access the latest news easily. During the COVID-19 pandemic, it is important for people to access the news so that they can take corresponding protective measures. However, the fake news is flooding and is a serious issue especially under the global pandemic.

arxiv-2111-01527.title: Household Cloth Object Set: Fostering Benchmarking in Deformable Object Manipulation
arxiv-2111-01527.creator: Irene Garcia-Camacho, Júlia Borràs, Berk Calli, Adam Norton, Guillem Alenyà
arxiv-2111-01527.description: Abstract Benchmarking of robotic manipulations is one of the open issues in robotic research. An important factor that has enabled progress in this area in the last decade is the existence of common object sets that have been shared among different research groups.

arxiv-2111-12282.title: Extending binary linear codes to self-orthogonal codes
arxiv-2111-12282.creator: Jon-Lark Kim
arxiv-2111-12282.description: Abstract Kim et al. (2021) gave a method to embed a given binary [ n , k ] [n,k] code 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ( k = 3 , 4 ) (k=3,4) into a self-orthogonal code of the shortest length which has the same dimension k k and minimum distance d ′ ≥ d ⁡ ( 𝒞 ) d^{\prime}\geq d(\mathcal{C}) .

arxiv-2202-11925.title: Formation and Morphology of the First Galaxies in the Cosmic Morning
arxiv-2202-11925.creator: Changbom Park, Jaehyun Lee, Juhan Kim, Donghui Jeong, Christophe Pichon, Brad K. Gibson, Owain N. Snaith, Jihye Shin, Yonghwi Kim, Yohan Dubois, C. Gareth Few
arxiv-2202-11925.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Changbom Park, Jaehyun Lee, Juhan Kim, Donghui Jeong, Christophe Pichon, Brad K. Gibson, Owain N. Snaith, Jihye Shin, Yonghwi Kim, Yohan Dubois, C. Gareth Few. We investigate the formation and morphological evolution of the first galaxies in the cosmic morning ( 10 ≳ z ≳ 4 10\gtrsim z\gtrsim 4 ) using the Horizon Run 5 ( HR5 ) simulation.

arxiv-2308-06687.title: Root Cross Z Z -Complementary Pairs with Large ZCZ Width
arxiv-2308-06687.creator: Shibsankar Das, Adrish Banerjee, Zilong Liu
arxiv-2308-06687.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shibsankar Das, Adrish Banerjee, Zilong Liu. In this paper, we present a new family of cross Z Z -complementary pairs (CZCPs) based on generalized Boolean functions and two roots of unity. Our key idea is to consider an arbitrary partition of the set { 1 , 2 , ⋯ , n } \{1,2,\cdots,n\} with two subsets corresponding to two given roots of unity for which two truncated sequences of new alphabet size determined by the two roots of unity are obtained.

arxiv-2405-13265.title: Homodyne detection is optimal for quantum interferometry with path-entangled coherent states
arxiv-2405-13265.creator: Z. M. McIntyre, W. A. Coish
arxiv-2405-13265.description: Abstract We present measurement schemes that do not rely on photon-number resolving detectors, but that are nevertheless optimal for estimating a differential phase shift in interferometry with either an entangled coherent state or a qubit–which-path state (where the path taken by a coherent-state wavepacket is entangled with the state of a qubit).

arxiv-2408-11154.title: Tight entropy bound based on p-quasinorms.
arxiv-2408-11154.creator: Juan Pablo Lopez
arxiv-2408-11154.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Juan Pablo Lopez. In the present paper we prove a family of tight upper and lower bounds for the Shannon entropy and von Neumann entropy based on the p-norms. This allows us to have an entropy estimate, a criterion for the finiteness of it and a bound on the difference of entropy, additionally, we did some numerical tests that show the efficiency of our approximations. Keywords:
Entropy, Estimate, Bound.

arxiv-2408-16645.title: SODAWideNet++: Combining Attention and Convolutions for Salient Object Detection
arxiv-2408-16645.creator: Rohit Venkata Sai Dulam, Chandra Kambhamettu
arxiv-2408-16645.description: Abstract Salient Object Detection (SOD) has traditionally relied on feature refinement modules that utilize the features of an ImageNet pre-trained backbone. However, this approach limits the possibility of pre-training the entire network because of the distinct nature of SOD and image classification.

arxiv-2409-01495.title: The Compressor-Retriever Architecture for Language Model OS
arxiv-2409-01495.creator: Yuan Yang, Siheng Xiong, Ehsan Shareghi & Faramarz Fekri
arxiv-2409-01495.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced their capacity to aggregate and process information across multiple modalities, enabling them to perform a wide range of tasks such as multimodal data querying, tool usage, web interactions, and handling long documents.

arxiv-2506-08094.creator: Mitchell Woolley
arxiv-2506-08094.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mitchell Woolley. 6d (2,0) SCFTs of type 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} have protected subsectors that were conjectured in [ 1 ] to be captured by 𝒲 𝔤 {\cal W}_{\mathfrak{g}} algebras. We write down the crossing equations for mixed four-point functions ⟨ S k 1 ​ S k 2 ​ S k 3 ​ S k 4 ⟩ \langle S_{k_{1}}S_{k_{2}}S_{k_{3}}S_{k_{4}}\rangle of 1/2-BPS operators S k i S_{k_{i}} in 6d (2,0) theories and detail how a certain twist reduces this system to a 2d meromorphic CFT multi-correlator bootstrap

arxiv-2602-18823.title: EvalSense: A Framework for Domain-Specific LLM (Meta-)Evaluation Thanks: Work done while at NHS England.
arxiv-2602-18823.creator: Adam Dejl, Jonathan Pearson
arxiv-2602-18823.description: Abstract Robust and comprehensive evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for identifying effective LLM system configurations and mitigating risks associated with deploying LLMs in sensitive domains. However, traditional statistical metrics are poorly suited to open-ended generation tasks, leading to growing reliance on LLM-based evaluation methods.

britannica-1911-gottsched-johann-christo.title: Gottsched, Johann Christoph (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-gottsched-johann-christo.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-gottsched-johann-christo.description: Article 'Gottsched, Johann Christoph' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. author and critic, was born on the 2nd of February 1700, at Judithenkirch near Königsberg, the son of a Lutheran clergyman. He studied philosophy and history at the university of his native town, but immediately on taking the degree of Magister in 1723, fled to Leipzig in order to evade impressment in the Prussian military service.

plos-pone-0011194.creator: Koichi Hasegawa, Johji Miwa
plos-pone-0011194.description: PLOS ONE research article. The phase II detoxification enzymes execute a major protective role against xenobiotics as well as endogenous toxicants. To understand how xenobiotics regulate phase II enzyme expression, acrylamide was selected as a model xenobiotic chemical, as it induces a large number and a v

pmc-10669300.title: Mill Scale-Derived Magnetite Nanoparticles: A Novel Substrate for Lactate Oxidase-Based Biosensors
pmc-10669300.creator: Hamid Khosravi, Oscar Carreras-Gallo, Jasmina Casals-Terré
pmc-10669300.description: Recycling and revalorization of waste are currently essential for sustainable growth. Mill scale, a waste product from steel production industries, which contains high levels of iron and minimal impurities, is proposed in this study as the source to synthesize magnetite nanoparticles (Fe3O4) for an enhancement of a lactate biosensor range.

pmc-10976613.title: Between neurodiversity and therapy: the importance of making conscious and responsible choices in supporting individuals on the autism spectrum
pmc-10976613.creator: Przemysław Bąbel, Paweł Ostaszewski
pmc-10976613.description: in the pace and manner of human development, with all its behavioral (including psychological) consequences [1]. Voices advocating for a shift from the previously “medicalized” perspective to accepting the fact that people develop and behave differently are becoming more prominent [2]. This perspective suggests modifying the social conditions in which they function.

pmc-11383544.title: Controlling Nutritional Status Score Predicts 1-Year Outcomes in Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension
pmc-11383544.creator: Takeshi Adachi, Shiro Adachi, Yoshihisa Nakano, Itsumure Nishiyama, Miku Hirose, Toyoaki Murohara
pmc-11383544.description: BackgroundThe prognosis for patients with chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) using their nutritional status has not been established. We investigated the relationship between the prognosis of patients with CTEPH and the Controlling Nutritional Status (CONUT) score, which is a nutritional assessment tool.Methods and ResultsA total of 157 patients with CTEPH was enrolled in the study.

pmc-11465835.title: Exploring predictors of interaction among low-birth-weight infants and their caregivers: a machine learning–based random forest approach
pmc-11465835.creator: Qihui Wang, Wenying Gao, Yi Duan, Zijin Ren, Ying Zhang
pmc-11465835.description: BackgroundQuality caregiver-infant interaction is crucial for infant growth, health, and development. Traditional methods for evaluating the quality of caregiver-infant interaction have predominantly relied on rating scales or observational techniques. However, rating scales are prone to inaccuracies, while observational techniques are resource-intensive.

pmc-11499285.title: Small Molecule Drug C381 Attenuates Brain Vascular Damage Following Repetitive Mild Traumatic Injury
pmc-11499285.creator: Lulin Li, Andy Nguyen, Brian Zhao, Ryan Vest, Lakshmi Yerra, Bryan Sun, Jian Luo
pmc-11499285.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains a significant public health concern, with no effective therapeutic interventions to ameliorate the enduring consequences. The prevailing understanding of TBI pathophysiology indicates a central role for vascular dysfunction. Transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) is a multifunctional cytokine crucial for vascular development. Aberrant TGF-β signaling is implicated in vascular pathologies associated with various neurological conditions.

pmc-11577541.title: Predicting the risk of mortality in children with dengue-induced hepatitis admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit
pmc-11577541.creator: Thanh Tat Nguyen, Phuong Thi-Mai Ngo, Luan Thanh Vo
pmc-11577541.description: BACKGROUNDDengue-associated acute liver failure (PALF) accounts for a high mortality rate in children admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU). To date, there is a lack of data on clinical algorithms for estimating the risk of mortality in pediatric patients with dengue-induced severe hepatitis (DISH).

pmc-12716974.title: Women Planned for Immediate Lymphatic Reconstruction During Axillary Lymph Node Dissection Should Be Reconstructable: Improving Intraoperative Team Collaboration
pmc-12716974.creator: Spencer Yakaback, Rosalie Morrish, Golpira Elmi Assadzadeh, Antoine Bouchard-Fortier, Alexandra Hatchell, Jennifer Matthews, Claire Temple-Oberle
pmc-12716974.description: Introduction: Immediate lymphatic reconstruction (ILR) during axillary lymph node dissection (ALND) has been shown to reduce breast cancer-related lymphedema (BCRL). However, some authors report many “non-reconstructable” patients, meaning that there were no suitable lymphatics or veins available in the axilla to complete the reconstructive procedure once the extirpative portion was complete.

pmc-13024698.title: Comprehensive Proteomic Profiling Reveals Dysregulation of Angiogenesis and Inflammatory Pathways in the Brains of SIRT3 Knockout Mice
pmc-13024698.creator: Qingping He, Samia Khan, Linlin Wang, Gordon C. Ibeanu, P. Andy Li
pmc-13024698.description: Background: Sirtuin 3 (SIRT3), a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase, plays a central role in regulating mitochondrial metabolism, oxidative stress, and cell survival. Although SIRT3 has been implicated in angiogenesis, apoptosis, and inflammation, its global proteomic impact on the brain remains unclear.

pmc-13086377.title: Beta testing and clinical evaluation of an artificial intelligence-powered clinical decision support system for endodontic case assessment
pmc-13086377.creator: Rohan Gupta
pmc-13086377.description: Background:Structured clinical digital decision support may help reduce variability in endodontic diagnosis, case difficulty assessment, and referral communication.Aim:To evaluate the agreement between a structured clinical decision support system for endodontic case assessment and independent expert endodontist judgement.Materials and Methods:Sixty anonymised simulated endodontic cases were entered into a previously developed clinical decision support system.

pmc-13216851.title: The second Trump presidency: Health care themes, policies, and impacts in his first year back in office
pmc-13216851.creator: Thomas Rice, Lynn Y Unruh, Andrew J Barnes, Erica Richardson
pmc-13216851.description: Highlights•This article reviews the Trump administration’s health actions during the first year in office.•Trump has focused on reducing the size of government, cutting programs, and staff.•Particularly deep cuts are being made to Medicaid and the ACA marketplaces.•Cuts to NIH, CDC, and other agencies will reduce data collection and analysis.•Health status may decline both domestically and internationally.

pmc-13391488.title: Metasurface-enhanced mid-infrared imaging spectroscopy with broadband quantum cascade lasers
pmc-13391488.creator: Ivan Sinev, Alessio Cargioli, Diego Piciocchi, Felix Ulrich Brikh, Jérôme Faist, Hatice Altug
pmc-13391488.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mid-infrared spectroscopy offers unparalleled opportunities in sensing through chemically specific detection of molecular absorption fingerprints. Yet its practical applications are limited by weak light-matter interaction and complex and relatively slow instrumentation relying on scanning components. Here, we develop a rapid imaging-based mid-IR spectroscopy platform that combines broadband resonance gradient metasurfaces and radiofrequency-modulated quantum cascade laser generating broad (250 cm−1) instantaneous spectrum.

pmc-13412800.title: Association Between Systolic Blood Pressure at Emergency Department Arrival and Time to Bleeding Cessation in Adult Non-Traumatic Epistaxis: A Retrospective Time-to-Event Analysis
pmc-13412800.creator: Phawinee Phiromkanchanasak, Suwijahk Chaiphrom, Bhumsapanan Thiamkaew, Wannagon Thanadolyothin, Wachira Wongtanasarasin
pmc-13412800.description: Objectives: Epistaxis is a common emergency department (ED) presentation, but the prognostic significance of triage blood pressure (BP) remains unclear. We evaluated whether elevated systolic BP (SBP) at ED arrival was associated with delayed bleeding cessation in adults with non-traumatic epistaxis.

pmc-13550261.title: PediLoc® blade plate yields faster consolidation rates than LCP pediatric condylar plate in distal femoral osteotomies: a retrospective comparison and description of surgical technique
pmc-13550261.creator: Samuel Tschudi, Cyrill Delay, Britta Krautwurst, Domenic Grisch, Thomas Dreher

pmc-13561665.title: A Context‐Based Narrative Moral Distress Scale for Nurses and Nursing Students
pmc-13561665.creator: Hsun‐Kuei Ko, Wei‐Ting Lai, Shu‐Li Lee, Min‐Tao Hsu, Hsiu‐Yueh Wu, Li‐Min Wu
pmc-13561665.description: Traditional moral distress scales primarily measure sources rather than contextualized responses. This study developed and validated the Narrative Moral Distress Scale, a context‐based instrument for assessing multidimensional moral distress in nurses and nursing students. In Phase 1, narrative stories and items were generated from previous qualitative transcripts of 32 nurses, followed by expert validation and face validation.

pmc-13566259.title: Comparative Clinical Outcomes Between Successive Generations of Liberty Trifocal Intraocular Lenses
pmc-13566259.creator: Juan J. Prados-Carmona, Mayelín Pérez-Perdomo, Álvaro Sánchez-Ventosa, Marta Villalba-González, Miguel González-Andrades, Alberto Villarrubia-Cuadrado, Antonio Cano-Ortiz, Yolanda Jiménez-Gómez
pmc-13566259.description: Purpose: To compare the clinical and functional outcomes of two successive generations of a trifocal intraocular lens (IOL), the original Liberty 677MY and the optimized Liberty 677CMY. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first head-to-head comparison between two successive generations of any IOL model reported.

pmc-13680508.title: Characterization of hypothetical proteins reveals function modules and virulence factors in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-13680508.creator: Chunyan Yao, Beifang Lu, Yiqing Ding, Letong Xu, Jingui Liu, Yingchao Zhang, Jiadai Huang, Yue Sun, Na Liu, Fang Chen, Shumin Li, Tianmin Li, Tongtong Feng, Youyue Li, Guoliang Qian, Aixin Yan, Xiaolong Shao, Xin Deng
pmc-13680508.description: Hypothetical proteins (HPs), known as biological dark matter, are genetic sequences of which the biological functions and regulatory processes remain largely unclear. In Pseudomonas aeruginosa, HPs account for 36.4% of all coding genes, representing a significant gap in understanding their functions and contribution to the virulence network.
